name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the immediate risk of further repression by Lukashenka’s regime in Belarus – threats from the Investigative Committee
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Union and its member countries to do more to protect Belarusians who face punishment from Lukashenka's government for protesting or speaking out, even when they live abroad. It wants easier visas and residence permits for them, new sanctions on officials, more support for independent media and civil society, and action against Belarusian spying and disinformation. It also calls for all political prisoners to be freed. This is a statement of the Parliament's position, not a change in law.

- The Parliament asks EU countries to make visas and residence permits easier for exiled Belarusians.
- It urges new sanctions on officials and ignoring Interpol warrants used against Lukashenka's opponents.
- It calls for more support for independent media and for action against Belarusian disinformation.
